Dear Ms Meena a/p Pillai,

Thank you for contacting Teratai Bank. We reviewed your transfer of RM4,687.10 to Nur Aina binti Kassim on 28 August 2026 (transaction TXN-0124894). The transfer failed and the money was never returned to your account.

We will refund RM4,687.10 to your account within 7 working days. We apologise for the inconvenience this has caused you.

Yours sincerely,
Teratai Bank

Puan Aisyah binti Kassim,

Terima kasih kerana menghubungi pihak bank. Setakat ini, pihak bank belum dapat mengenal pasti transaksi yang Puan maksudkan, dan belum ada sebarang keputusan dibuat.

Untuk meneruskan semakan, sila balas mesej ini dengan tarikh transaksi, jumlahnya, serta nama pedagang atau penerima. Setelah maklumat itu diterima, pihak bank akan menyemak aduan Puan dengan segera.

Sekian, terima kasih.
Pihak Teratai Bank

Dear Ms Aisyah binti Kassim,

Thank you for contacting Teratai Bank. We reviewed your ATM withdrawal, transaction TXN-0088211, on 17 July 2026. You requested RM1,500.00, but the machine dispensed only RM950.00, leaving a shortfall of RM550.00.

We will refund the shortfall of RM550.00 to your account within 7 working days.

Yours sincerely,
Teratai Bank

Puan Nur Izzati binti Jamal,

Terima kasih kerana menghubungi pihak bank. Pihak bank telah menyemak caj kad anda di GoRide dan mengesahkan bahawa anda dikenakan caj dua kali bagi pembelian yang sama pada 18 Ogos 2026, iaitu transaksi TXN-0115571 dan TXN-0115572, masing-masing sebanyak RM46.66.

Pihak bank akan membayar balik caj yang kemudian (TXN-0115572) sebanyak RM46.66 ke akaun anda dalam tempoh 7 hari bekerja.

Sekian, terima kasih.
Pihak Teratai Bank

Dear Mr Shahrul bin Razak,

Thank you for contacting Teratai Bank. We have received your dispute about transaction TXN-0143340 of RM2,213.95 at LUXEGOODS LONDON on 19 September 2026.

Our fraud team is now investigating this transaction. They will contact you within 3 working days. After that, we will update you at least every 10 working days until the investigation is complete.

Yours sincerely,
Teratai Bank
